data.gender_notes: Shamsad is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shamsad is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', meaning Sun. In Hinduism, Surya is the god of the sun and is revered for his power and life-giving energy. Shamsad is a unisex name that represents light, wisdom, and the divine power of the sun. The name Shamsad carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shamsad usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The word 'Shamsad' itself resonates with the vibrant history and rich traditions of Indian culture.
